races.name: Buckley Agri New Holland Irish EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Only a handful are of any real interest, with LENNON GROVE's second in a Grade 2 mares bumper at Aintree in the spring catching the eye and she's taken to make a winning start over hurdles. The Besty Woman seems to be getting better with racing and is entitled to be in the mix, with Al Arrivee another threat providing this doesn't turn into a speed test.

  1. LENNON GROVE (IRE)
  2. THE BESTY WOMAN (IRE)
  3. AL ARRIVEE (FR)

races.name: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
GIVE IT A CRACK was placed on both starts in points, is in excellent hands and looks to have been found a winnable opportunity on hurdles debut. Course bumper winner Tell The Boys was well fancied when failing to complete on hurdling debut and may prove the main threat, while Coolishael and Rokanako bring the best previous form and are also capable of being involved.

  1. GIVE IT A CRACK
  2. TELL THE BOYS (IRE)
  3. COOLISHAEL (IRE)

races.name: Listowel Races Supporters Club Lartigue Hurdle (Handicap) In Memory Of John Molyneaux (Listed)
races.verdict:
O'GRADY CRACKER looked well ahead of his mark when successful at Cork earlier this summer and could be worth another chance. Ben Hur, Hopes Are High and Beauvallon also make plenty of appeal in a competitive renewal of this valuable handicap.

  1. O'GRADY CRACKER (IRE)
  2. BEAUVALLON (IRE)
  3. HOPES ARE HIGH (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
KILBRIN ROCCO returns to hurdling from a potentially lenient mark on recent chase form and is fancied to give the McCarthy yard a second successive win in this race. Jaadil hasn’t fired this season and is ideally suited by further, but a switch to a yard with a strong record at this meeting could spark a revival. Churchwarden returns to hurdles in good heart and is also respected.

  1. KILBRIN ROCCO (IRE)
  2. JAADIL (IRE)
  3. CHURCHWARDEN (IRE)

races.name: Behans Horseshoe Bar, Restaurant & Townhouse Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MART LANE is progressing in handicaps and went close at Galway 17 days ago despite a mistake 2 out, so is taken to go one better. Boston Rajj should strip fitter for the recent run and looks well treated on debut for new connections, while First Ascent is open to improvement and rates best of the rest. Killowen House can also be involved if handling this sharp track.

  1. MART LANE (IRE)
  2. BOSTON RAJJ (IRE)
  3. FIRST ASCENT (IRE)
  4. KILLOWEN HOUSE (IRE)

races.name: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
A cracking beginners chase. The vote goes to LOVE ME TENDER, who finished with running left when fourth on his chasing debut at the Galway Festival and the youngest of Willie Mullins' quartet seems sure to improve for that initial experience. Fort Dino left his chasing debut form well behind when runner-up at Killarney 5 weeks ago so heads up the threats, with I Will Be Baie and Largy Hill both adding another layer of intrigue returning from significant absences.

  1. LOVE ME TENDER (FR)
  2. FORT DINO (FR)
  3. I WILL BE BAIE (FR)

races.name: Kevin McManus Bookmaker Flat Race
races.verdict:
SIERRASCOPE showed plenty when fourth of 19 in a valuable sales bumper at the Punchestown Festival in the spring and is taken to confirm that promise by opening his Rules account at the second time of asking. Berkstar has an ordinary pedigree but must be feared having joined Willie Mullins after finishing runner-up on his sole outing in points earlier in the year. Veales Cross would also enter calculations if the subject of support.

  1. SIERRASCOPE
  2. BERKSTAR (IRE)
  3. VEALES CROSS (IRE)

races.name: ROA Shared Ownership Day Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
ALBEGONE is worth treating as if still in form and makes appeal in a thin-looking race. Bust A Moon went with much more encouragement at Carlisle last time and is also considered, with Jojo Rabbit still lurking on a handy mark if able to bounce back.

  1. ALBEGONE
  2. BUST A MOON
  3. JOJO RABBIT

races.name: Always Trying Racing Syndicate EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SILVERELLA should prove hard to beat with the form of her Goodwood success already looking strong. Fellow penalised-winner Rogue Crusader is the obvious threat in a thin novice.

  1. SILVERELLA
  2. ROGUE CRUSADER
  3. SCRAPPETALENE

races.name: Celebrating The Life Of Bobby Howard EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SAYIDAH BAHRA shaped with plenty of promise when fourth at Carlisle and she can find the requisite improvement to beat form-pick Iris Olivia. Bling offered something to work on at Newbury and is another to consider.

  1. SAYIDAH BAHRA (IRE)
  2. IRIS OLIVIA (IRE)
  3. BLING (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Nursery
races.verdict:
THE MEAN FIDDLER should benefit from the step back to 6f and gets the verdict in a competitive nursery. Fellow nursery debutants Diamond New Bay and Captaincy also appeal as potential improvers on the back of their novice wins.

  1. THE MEAN FIDDLER (IRE)
  2. DIAMOND NEW BAY (IRE)
  3. CAPTAINCY (IRE)

races.name: Simon Scrope Dalby Screw-Driver Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Lightly-raced 3-y-o HOLLYWELL STREAM has gone the right way since sent handicapping and can quickly resume winning ways at the expense of the front-running Noble Horizon, who's eased in class. Per Contra remains well treated and any support should be noted in his follow up bid, with Keep An Eye On It another to consider.

  1. HOLLYWELL STREAM (IRE)
  2. NOBLE HORIZON
  3. PER CONTRA (IRE)

races.name: Pontefract Prince Of Wales Hospice Handicap
races.verdict:
The improving THUNDER GODDESS can make light work of a penalty and follow up from last week's success here. Jam Lass hasn't had much racing this season and went with plenty of encouragement when third at Ripon last time, so is also shortlisted alongside Al Fujairah, who should be suited by this longer trip.

  1. THUNDER GODDESS
  2. JAM LASS
  3. AL FUJAIRAH (IRE)

races.name: Explore Shared Racehorse Ownership At inthepaddock.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
The in-form WOODSTOCK was third in a better race than this at Thirsk last time despite having an interrupted run, so he gets the nod over Fiscal Policy and Arduis Invicta, who both escape a penalty for their recent wins.

  1. WOODSTOCK
  2. FISCAL POLICY (IRE)
  3. ARDUIS INVICTA (IRE)

races.name: Weekend Winners On At The Races Handicap
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but the vote goes to RENEWABLE DREAM who took a step forward for his new handler when running on into third at Wolverhampton (form been well advertised since) and can gain a first win now returned to 1m here. Ocean Force rates a big danger if, as expected, proving better suited to this track than when sixth at Lingfield last time. C&D scorer Starakova and handicap debutante Roccapina are other likely players too in this competitive handicap.

  1. RENEWABLE DREAM
  2. OCEAN FORCE (IRE)
  3. STARAKOVA

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Nursery
races.verdict:
This is wide open. EEVEE STAR showed the benefit of blinkers when a resurgent fourth at Newcastle last time and eased 1 lb here, she can gain a breakthrough victory with the step up to 7f and the services of Billy Loughnane both likely positives. Richard Hannon's From Me To You advanced his form when third at Wolverhampton and heads the list of dangers off a handy-looking mark, while Claret And Blues and No More Pino can play a prominent role too.

  1. EEVEE STAR
  2. FROM ME TO YOU (IRE)
  3. CLARET AND BLUES

races.name: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SHADES OF MAY has fitness on his side over several returning from an absence here and he's likely to get things his own way if attempting to make all again so he's taken to handle the rise in grade and account for Feel The Need and Thapa VC, both of whom capable from their current mark but require truly-run affairs.

  1. SHADES OF MAY
  2. FEEL THE NEED
  3. THAPA VC (IRE)

races.name: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
LIEUTENANT KIJE has improved this year and stepped up again when a close third over C&D 21 days ago, beaten just a head despite dwelling at the start and first-time cheekpieces can help him open his account. Tasdeed showed much improved form when fourth at Kempton in first-time tongue strap after 5 months off and is feared most, whilst Bold Shout is unexposed and not one to write off.

  1. LIEUTENANT KIJE
  2. TASDEED (FR)
  3. BOLD SHOUT (IRE)

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LADY HENSHAW clearly derived plenty from her initial effort when finding just one too strong at Pontefract early last month and with further progress on the cards, Patrick Owens' filly gets the nod to make it third time lucky. There are a few interesting newcomers in opposition however, Hunstanton, Palms Oasis and Castlerock Girl preferred in that order before the benefit of market clues.

  1. LADY HENSHAW (IRE)
  2. HUNSTANTON
  3. PALMS OASIS

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
QILA just holds the edge on form and is taken to gain a deserved breakthrough victory at the chief expense of Believeinmenow who also arrives in very good nick and rates a big threat. Tim Easterby's new recruit Leading Times returns from a long absence but can also play a prominent role if fully tuned up.

  1. QILA
  2. BELIEVEINMENOW (IRE)
  3. LEADING TIMES

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
races.verdict:
FIORELLA PRINCESS is thriving since making the switch to Robert Cowell and is very hard to oppose under a 5-lb penalty for her wide-margin success at Yarmouth last week with Billy Loughnane again doing the steering. Elvetham also scored in taking style at Lingfield last time and appeals as the one to chase her home ahead of the consistent Court Drive.

  1. FIORELLA PRINCESS (IRE)
  2. ELVETHAM (IRE)
  3. COURT DRIVE (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
FLOATING MARKET won a race which is working out well last month and with more to offer upped to this trip in handicaps, she's taken to follow up at the expense of fellow handicap debutante Hamdania and the consistent Midnight Media.

  1. FLOATING MARKET
  2. HAMDANIA (IRE)
  3. MIDNIGHT MEDIA

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
MEET ME IN MERAKI ended a losing run at Chester recently and remains with handicapping scope so could well follow up with Loughnane in the saddle. Takeitorleaveit is hard to picture being outside the places unless he fails to handle the surface, while Lord Mayor should strip fitter for recent reappearance.

  1. MEET ME IN MERAKI
  2. TAKEITORLEAVEIT (IRE)
  3. LORD MAYOR

races.name: Plantation Stud British EBF Maiden Stakes
races.verdict:
Well-bred newcomer CODE OF HONOUR ticks plenty of boxes on paper and can make a winning start for top connections. The twice-raced Netherstream has shown plenty of promise and appeals as next best, with another debutant in Hamrin also worth a look in the betting.

  1. CODE OF HONOUR
  2. NETHERSTREAM
  3. HAMRIN (FR)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A competitive handicap with BEAR ON THE RUN getting the nod to progress further at the expense of Miss Nightcap. Last year's runner-up Lady Roxby should be in the mix with Woohoo and Powdering others to consider.

  1. BEAR ON THE RUN (IRE)
  2. MISS NIGHTCAP
  3. LADY ROXBY

races.name: Federation of Bloodstock Agents Nursery
races.verdict:
LAZURITE completed a simple task when blitzing her rivals at Lingfield last month and with potential of better to come now tackling a nursery for the first time, Richard Hughes' filly earns the vote. Black Velvet Boy was only narrowly denied the hat-trick last time, so he looks an obvious danger given his rate of progression, with Minzelle and the selection's stablemate Harry Knows taken to fight out third.

  1. LAZURITE
  2. BLACK VELVET BOY (IRE)
  3. MINZELLE (IRE)

races.name: Tattersalls Stakes (Registered As The Somerville Tattersall Stakes) (Group 3)
races.verdict:
GREAT BALLS O'FIRE picked up in taking fashion once he realised what was required when making a winning debut on the July course last month and with further improvement on the cards, he's taken to handle this marked step up in class in his stride for connections who can seemingly do no wrong. Mezzo Forte impressed when scoring at York recently, so he heads up the threats, with Varzi and Fuel The Jet taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. GREAT BALLS O'FIRE
  2. MEZZO FORTE (IRE)
  3. VARZI (IRE)

races.name: Jockey Club Rose Bowl Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
GREGORY looks the class act in this company and can make it 2-2 for the year. Arabian Force is a consistent operator at this level, and he's feared most stepping up to 2m for the first time. Magnetude could prove best of the rest if improving for a gelding operation/step up in trip.

  1. GREGORY
  2. ARABIAN FORCE (IRE)
  3. MAGNETUDE

races.name: Budds Horseracing Memorabilia Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This may well go to a 3-y-o, with KING OF BERKSHIRE taken to defy a penalty at the expense of turf debutant Charles Darnay. First Officer has a good record on this track and needs considering along with Astracornus, who tackles 1½m for the first time.

  1. KING OF BERKSHIRE (IRE)
  2. CHARLES DARNAY
  3. FIRST OFFICER (IRE)

races.name: JRA Japan Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
SIGNCASTLE CITY is back on his latest winning mark, and he gets the nod with the form of his latest third at Windsor working out well. A La Noche is weighted to make a bold bid for a follow up, while Warning Symbol and Media Legend look interesting among the 3-y-o contingent.

  1. SIGNCASTLE CITY (IRE)
  2. A LA NOCHE (IRE)
  3. WARNING SYMBOL (IRE)

races.name: Saltire Hospitality EBF Mares' 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Returning to maiden company, POETIC TWIST can give the excellent Sean Bowen/Gordon Elliott combination another winner at this track. Biglesisback is fancied to make more impact than in this corresponding race 12 months ago, while likely improvers Datstheholyallofit and Kingside Lady are by no means back numbers in a tricky opener.

  1. POETIC TWIST (IRE)
  2. BIGLESISBACK
  3. DATSTHEHOLYALLOFIT (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Perth Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
THE LAST CLOUD completed a hat-trick over hurdles at this course last summer and that augurs well considering he's more a chaser on looks, so he's an appealing candidate now stepping back up to a more suitable trip for his first start in this sphere. Tamarind Bay has proved a much-improved model since switching to fences and will be a big threat if taking up this engagement (also declared here on Wednesday). Walking On A Dream also has claims if picking up where he left off in the spring.

  1. THE LAST CLOUD (IRE)
  2. TAMARIND BAY (IRE)
  3. WALKING ON A DREAM (IRE)

races.name: House Of Bruar Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
EXPERT ANALYSIS is officially ahead of the handicapper having pulled well clear with a progressive rival at Sedgefield 10 days ago so he's hard to get away from. Curious Mrs Fox and Gonnino can offer most resistance.

  1. EXPERT ANALYSIS (IRE)
  2. CURIOUS MRS FOX
  3. GONNINO (IRE)

races.name: Equine Products UK Best Turned Out Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ANOTHER HIGH FIVE progressed nicely over hurdles last season and is expected to make up into a better chaser, so he's a fascinating contender on reappearance with 3m also in his favour. Upfordebate and Sean Og finished first and second in this race a year ago and are respected, while Juke Hill isn't passed over lightly for this jockey/trainer combination.

  1. ANOTHER HIGH FIVE (IRE)
  2. UPFORDEBATE (IRE)
  3. SEAN OG (IRE)

races.name: Edinburgh Gin Owner Trainer Jockey Awards Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LETTERSTON LILY has improved again since her impressive reappearance win here in April and looks the one to be with if lining up (entered here on Wednesday). In-form Al Sayah must hold every chance if jumping better than at Cartmel last time, while the returning Letterston Lady (full sister to the selection) completes a strong hand for the Bowen team.

  1. LETTERSTON LILY
  2. AL SAYAH
  3. LETTERSTON LADY

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WAY MAKER could do with brushing up his jumping but this step up in trip may place less pressure on that department and the strong suspicion is that he's better than his opening mark. Jetovango is very interesting starting out for Triston Davidson, with Broken Ice another to consider.

  1. WAY MAKER (IRE)
  2. JETOVANGO (IRE)
  3. BROKEN ICE (IRE)

races.name: A Place For You Here Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TIGRESS LILLY could be poised to go one better following a much-improved second here last time. The Bowen brothers are well represented with Gortmore Lady and Forest Spirit respectively, while Chief Sunday would be interesting if supported.

  1. TIGRESS LILLY
  2. GORTMORE LADY (IRE)
  3. FOREST SPIRIT (IRE)

Prix Du Haras Du Mazet Stakes

Prix De L'ordre International Des Anysetiers Handicap
Prix Haras Des Petits Champs Handicap
Px Du C. Des Partenaires De L'hipp. De La Teste-h. De La Petite Brunie Handicap
